name: Spiral 22. shell Dream Cature
shortDescription: My largest dream catcher, transformed from a frustrating diamond-spiral design into a hanging copper-and-.22-shell spiral with amethyst and a naturally curled feather.
description: This is the largest dream catcher I made. It began as a diamond-spiral design with leather ties holding the structure together. I used a copper core threaded with .22 shells and alternated red and black webbing from row to row.

The project took about two months and eventually became frustrating enough that I planned to scrap it. When I cut the center core and leather cords, however, the structure naturally hung in a shape I liked, turning the failed original layout into the final spiral design.

I finished the center using three pieces of raw amethyst on a black thread core. I also added a feather from one of my chickens whose feathers naturally spiraled, which matched the accidental spiral form of the finished piece.
